pages.title: Command registration, dispatch, and runtime behavior
pages.purpose: How a step invocation runs: init()-based command registration, urfave/cli app configuration and custom help templates, context middleware injection, plugin fallback for unknown commands, error presentation, STEPDEBUG, and the panic handler.
instructions: Cover exit-code and stderr behavior including the messenger interface and STEPDEBUG=1
Cover how version/build metadata is injected at build time

pages.title: Architecture and ownership boundaries
pages.purpose: System-level architecture: layering from cmd/step/main.go through internal/cmd to command groups and shared flow packages, ownership boundaries, and the role of external smallstep modules (cli-utils, certificates, go.step.sm/crypto).
instructions: Describe ownership boundaries between this repo and the smallstep/certificates, cli-utils, and go.step.sm/crypto modules
Do not enumerate every file; explain systems and relationships

pages.title: STEPPATH, defaults.json, and contexts
pages.purpose: The on-disk state model: $STEPPATH layout, defaults.json, contexts.json, authority vs profile separation, when contexts are activated (UseContext), and the step path command.
instructions: Explain when contexts switch from disabled to enabled
Explain which files bootstrap writes and with which permissions

pages.title: ACME certificate flow
pages.purpose: The ACMEv2 client path: ACMECreateCertFlow and ACMESignCSRFlow, standalone vs webroot challenge serving (http-01), EAB key management subcommands, and how step ca certificate selects ACME.
instructions: Cover the beta exposure of the acme group
Explain why ACME provisioners reject the JWT token flow

pages.title: CA initialization and bootstrap
pages.purpose: step ca init (deployment types standalone/linked/hosted, PKI generation via certificates/pki, KMS-backed key URIs, non-interactive flags, default ACME provisioner) and step ca bootstrap (root fetch and verification, defaults.json, context creation, team authority API lookup).
instructions: Cover the api.smallstep.com team endpoint used by --team
Distinguish hosted/linked/standalone behavior by code, not marketing

pages.title: Certificate issuance flow (sign, certificate, offline mode)
pages.purpose: End-to-end X.509 issuance: CertificateFlow, online vs offline CA clients (CaClient interface), CSR and SAN construction, sign requests/responses, cert writing, and KMS-backed keys.
instructions: Explain the OfflineCA singleton and why it exists
Explain what the shared flowContext carries between token and certificate flows

pages.title: Certificate renewal, rekey, and revocation
pages.purpose: Renewal semantics: mTLS vs token-based renewal, force, daemon mode scheduling (2/3 lifetime rule, --expires-in, --renew-period), after-renew hooks (signal pid, exec command), rekey, revoke, and the systemd timer/service integration.
instructions: Explain nextRenewDuration scheduling math and its edge cases
Note that daemon mode forces renewal regardless of validity

pages.title: Provisioner token generation flow
pages.purpose: How step builds single-use JWTs for the CA: audience construction per token type, provisioner dispatch (JWK, OIDC, X5C, Nebula, SSHPOP, K8sSA, cloud identity providers, ACME/SCEP errors), token claims and headers, key loading, and renew tokens.
instructions: Cover claim names (sans, sha, cnf, user, ssh) and where they are set
Map each token type to the CA endpoint path used as the JWT audience

pages.title: Change guide: adding a new command
pages.purpose: Focused maintenance guide: register a new subcommand via init() and command.Register, wire it into internal/cmd blank imports, share flags via the flags package, follow errs/ui conventions, and add testscript coverage.
instructions: Cover documentation/help-text conventions used by existing commands
Show the minimal registration pattern with concrete code references

pages.title: Change guide: adding a provisioner token flow
pages.purpose: Focused maintenance guide: extend NewTokenFlow's provisioner switch with a new provisioner type, implement a generator in token_generator.go, add token options/claims, and handle the error-only pattern used for ACME/SCEP.
instructions: Note where provisioner types come from smallstep/certificates
Use X5C and SSHPOP as worked examples of provisioner-specific generators

pages.title: CA management: provisioners, admins, policies, and API tokens
pages.purpose: Management-plane commands against the step-ca Admin API: step ca provisioner CRUD plus webhooks, step ca admin CRUD, step ca policy (x509/ssh/acme allow-deny rules), step api token create, and admin client credential handling in cautils.
instructions: Cover offline-mode caveats for management commands if the code establishes them
Explain how NewAdminClient obtains admin X5C credentials when none are given

pages.title: KMS URIs, step-kms-plugin, and the plugin system
pages.purpose: External tool integration: how cryptoutil routes keys/certs/signers between files and KMS URIs, how step-kms-plugin is invoked (key, sign, attest, jwk, create), plugin discovery (LookPath) and execution, and the exec package's process behaviors.
instructions: Explain Windows plugin handling (.ps1, PATHEXT)
Explain the Attestor interface and TPM/attestation usage where the code shows it

pages.title: Build, release, and packaging
pages.purpose: The build/distribution system: Makefile targets and ldflags version injection, GoReleaser Pro configuration (cross-compile matrix, nfpm deb/rpm, cosign signing, S3 blobs, winget/scoop manifests), docker images, scripts, and release workflows.
instructions: Distinguish make build from make goreleaser parity builds
List supported GOOS/GOARCH targets from the config
State what is established by repo files versus unknown (e.g., CI secrets)

pages.title: Testing strategy
pages.purpose: How the repo is verified: testify unit tests, testscript (txtar) integration tests wired through TestMain mapping step to cmd.Run, representative test suites, and CI (smallstep/workflows goCI, golangci-lint remote config, govulncheck, code scanning).
instructions: Explain how to run the integration tests and what a txtar contains
Note which unit tests exist for flows (token_flow_test, offline_test)

pages.title: Crypto and JOSE toolkit: step crypto
pages.purpose: The general crypto toolkit: jwt/jws/jwe/jwk (create, thumbprint, keyset), otp, kdf (scrypt/argon2 via internal/kdf, bcrypt via pkg/bcrypt_pbkdf), nacl, hash, rand, key operations, and base64; reliance on go.step.sm/crypto.
instructions: Cover winpe where it fits
Explain how password prompting is injected into pemutil/jose at app startup

pages.title: OAuth and OIDC: step oauth
pages.purpose: The OAuth 2.0 / OIDC command: authorization-code flow with a local HTTP listener, out-of-band mode, device authorization flow, JWT bearer, refresh tokens, and how the OIDC provisioner token flow shells out to step oauth via exec.Step.
instructions: Cover the --listen, --console, --oidc, --bare behaviors
Note the embedded public Google client IDs and their intended use

pages.title: SSH certificates: step ssh
pages.purpose: The SSH certificate toolkit: login/logout with the ssh-agent, certificate/renew/rekey/revoke, inspect, fingerprint, checkHost, config, hosts, proxycommand, and needs-renewal; agent interaction via internal/sshutil.
instructions: Cover agent discovery across platforms
Explain the SSHPOP token usage for renew/rekey/revoke

pages.title: Local X.509 tooling: step certificate and step crl
pages.purpose: The offline certificate toolkit: create, sign, inspect, lint, bundle, p12, format, verify, install/uninstall (truststore), fingerprint, needs-renewal, root/leaf creation; plus the step crl group and internal/crlutil.
instructions: Cover KMS/template hooks where present
Cover truststore installation behavior and its platform dependency

pages.title: Quickstart: build, run, and test step
pages.purpose: Practical onboarding: what the repo is, how to build and run the step binary, run unit and integration tests, and where to navigate next in the wiki.
instructions: Ground every non-obvious statement in repository evidence with bounded repo:// spans
State uncertainty when the repository does not establish a fact; do not invent runtime or deployment details
